name: Thuraya SG-2520
pros: 1.3 MP camera capable of capturing good photos for its release era
Li-Ion 1280 mAh battery offers solid operating endurance for daily use
Expandable memory via SD ( 128 MB included )
cons: No official IP rating for dust or water resistance
Standard charging speeds without ultra-fast charging support

reviews.title: Solid performance for its 2007 launch era
reviews.body: Picking this up around its release period, the WinCE 4.2 experience felt snappy and responsive for the price tier. The 1.3 MP camera delivered reliable shots in outdoor lighting.

reviews.title: Reliable battery and daily usability
reviews.body: The Li-Ion 1280 mAh power cell paired with Thuraya's software tuning easily lasted through a full work day with mixed web browsing, calls, and media playback.

reviews.title: Refined hardware styling and build
reviews.body: The physical chassis of the Thuraya SG-2520 feels well-balanced in hand. Its 138.5 x 53 x 18.8 mm (5.45 x 2.09 x 0.74 in) make it easy to hold during long daily sessions.

reviews.title: Great value for the hardware specifications
reviews.body: For the price point, getting standard platform performance alongside 128MB storage, SD slot made the Thuraya SG-2520 an easy recommendation among rivals in 2007.

reviews.title: Smooth day-to-day software responsiveness
reviews.body: Operating on WinCE 4.2, the user interface is intuitive with smooth system transitions. Core apps and browsing run without noticeable stutter.

reviews.title: Dependable display and audio clarity
reviews.body: The screen (Removable Li-Ion 1280 mAh battery, 1.9", 176x220 pixels) produces vibrant colors for video streaming, and call clarity through the earpiece is crystal clear.

reviews.title: A well-rounded package from Thuraya
reviews.body: Overall, the Thuraya SG-2520 proved to be a durable and well-engineered mobile device representing Thuraya's design philosophy nicely.
